mapper.select: select r.id, r.id as recordId, r.method, r.category, r.question, r.cast_at as castAt, left(i.content_md, 120) as contentPreview from div_record r left join div_interpretation i on i.record_id = r.id and i.id = (select max(i2.id) from div_interpretation i2 where i2.record_id = r.id) where r.user_id = #{userId} and (r.question like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or i.content_md like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by r.created_at desc
select method as name, count(*) as count from div_record where user_id = #{userId} group by method order by count desc
select category as name, count(*) as count from div_record where user_id = #{userId} group by category order by count desc
